scorecard.rationale: The Parkinson corn-oil comparison favored DHA plus EPA on depression response while the comparator also had responders. The authentic table and oil grade remain open. In non-Parkinson studies, both the coronary mixed-oil trial and the Alzheimer OmegAD full-sample depression comparison were inconclusive. None isolates refined corn oil against no oil. Supplemental COPD estimates under a 50:50 corn and soy comparator have opposite depression signs across active arms, with both intervals spanning zero. Two carotenoid studies used corn oil as the carrier in active and placebo capsules. Their immune markers establish neither an isolated corn-oil effect nor a depressive symptom outcome. Corn oil is the common injection vehicle in the original tamoxifen-induced VPS35 model. Its depletion and behavioral outcomes cannot identify a refined culinary corn oil effect. There was no oil-free arm and the animal behavioral phenotype is distinct from clinical depression.
